verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs include a first-party API reference and a separate Examples section. API pages such as the SSR and Custom Renderer references document APIs with code samples. Nothing in the pack shows that the API reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser. missing for 10: evidence that API reference examples are runnable or editable in-browser, documentation of interactive exploration features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
